W.note: Nicely pitted peel but the body is a near-symmetric egg with only faint nubs, and on phone the panel and readout cover the fruit.

X.note: Reads as a real lemon with stem stub, nipple, waxy highlight and soft shadow, plus clean staging and a good phone layout, though the shape is a little pear-like.

Y.note: Large, convincing lemon with a pointed nipple, stem and calyx and pitted peel, a slightly flat matte look but solid geometry that holds up when orbited.

Z.note: Washed-out grey-white translucent blob with meridian lines and no visible lemon shape, and the phone panel covers it.
